name: Web clipper
author: Pergame
description: Clip pages, posts and videos into notes (the ReadItLater feature set): per-type folder, title and body templates, batch clipping, images as attachments.

settings.label: Default workspace
settings.hint: New clips land here unless the clip dialog picks another one.

settings.label: Folder path template
settings.hint: Rendered inside the workspace; missing folders are created. Variables: contentType (the type's slug), date, title, author.

settings.label: Date format
settings.hint: Tokens: YYYY, YY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss. Used by the {{date}} template variable.

settings.label: When a note with the same title exists
settings.hint: Pergame allows duplicate names; this only affects a title you already used today.

settings.label: Batch URL delimiter
settings.hint: Used by 'clip every URL in the clipboard'.

settings.label: Zhihu cookie (optional)
settings.hint: Zhihu blocks anonymous reads. Paste your own Cookie header value to clip zhihu.com pages.

settings.label: Render engine

choices.label: Auto (external MCP when endpoint set, else local CLI)

settings.hint: Dev machines: install camoufox-cli and its browser, keep the endpoint empty. Production: point the endpoint at the camofox-mcp container.

settings.label: Use camoufox browser service
settings.hint: Pages behind anti-scraping walls (Zhihu) need a real browser. Requires a self-hosted camoufox MCP service. Zhihu anonymous access is probabilistic — set the Zhihu cookie below for a deterministic pass.

settings.label: Camoufox MCP endpoint
settings.hint: Production container DNS name (pergame-backend joins the camofox network). /mcp appended if missing.

settings.label: Camoufox API token
settings.placeholder: Bearer token (empty when auth is off)
settings.hint: Sent as Authorization: Bearer …

settings.label: Render timeout (seconds)
settings.hint: How long the page may take to load before extraction. Drives every timeout in the chain — raise it on slow networks.

settings.label: Folder / tag
settings.hint: Folder name (from the path template) and the tag applied to clips of this type.

settings.label: Title template
settings.hint: Variables: title, author, date, url, contentType.

settings.label: Body template
settings.hint: Variables: content, title, description, author, published, url, date, contentType.
